title: Grand China with a Yangtze River Cruise
alt: Cruise ship passing the cliffs of the Qutang gorge on the Yangtze
transport: Private transfers, an internal flight, bullet trains and a river cruise

stops.name: Shanghai
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Practical base in Jing'an with metro access

program.name: Shanghai
program.description: One night to land and settle before the flight inland to Chongqing and the river.

stops.name: Yangtze River
stops.subtitle: Chongqing → Fengdu → the Three Gorges
stops.accom: 3 nights · Full board · Standard cabin · 5★ · River ship with all meals and shore visits on board

activities.name: Chongqing guided city tour
activities.description: A guided afternoon through the hillside city, taking in Hongya Cave, the Liberation Monument and the old street at Longmenhao.

activities.name: Fengdu Ghost City
activities.description: A shore visit to the temples and painted stone figures on Ming mountain, built around old Chinese beliefs about the afterlife.

activities.name: Qutang and Wu gorges
activities.description: A full day on deck as the ship threads the sheer cliffs of the Qutang gorge and the long green narrows of the Wu gorge.

program.name: Yangtze River
program.description: Three nights aboard the Victoria Jenna with all meals, a shore visit at Fengdu and a full day through the Three Gorges.

stops.name: Shanghai
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable base in Putuo close to the metro

activities.name: Three Gorges Dam
activities.description: A guided look at the largest power station ever built, with the ship locks, the spillway and the long viewing platforms.

activities.name: Half day guided tour of Shanghai
activities.description: A guided morning through the Bund waterfront, the old town lanes and the rockeries and ponds of the Yu garden.

activities.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
activities.description: Tickets up the city's best known tower, with the glass floor over Pudong and a long view back to the colonial Bund.

activities.name: Huangpu river cruise
activities.description: An evening sailing between the lit towers of Pudong and the stone facades of the Bund, the classic Shanghai skyline shot.

program.name: Shanghai
program.description: Two nights back in the port city for the Bund, the Yu garden, the Oriental Pearl Tower and a cruise on the Huangpu.

stops.name: Beijing
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel in Chaoyang, close to the metro

activities.name: Great Wall at Mutianyu and the Summer Palace
activities.match: Full-Day Great Wall & Summer Palace Tour
activities.description: The Mutianyu section of the wall, steep and far less crowded than Badaling, then the lake and long corridor of the Summer Palace.

activities.name: Beijing city sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through Tiananmen Square, the courtyards of the Forbidden City and the round halls of the Temple of Heaven.

program.name: Beijing
program.description: Two nights in the capital to finish, with the wall at Mutianyu, the Summer Palace and the imperial centre.

expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: Three nights on the Yangtze turn a city holiday into a proper journey. You watch the country change from the top deck.
expert.tip: Ask for a cabin on the upper deck, port side. The best of the gorge scenery passes on that side going downstream.

summary: Nine days from Shanghai to the Yangtze and on to Beijing: a guided afternoon in Chongqing, three full board nights aboard the Victoria Jenna through the Three Gorges, then the Bund and the Great Wall at Mutianyu.
included: Included: 8 nights with meals as listed; the Shanghai to Chongqing flight; private transfers and bullet trains; guided Chongqing city tour; 3 full board nights on the Victoria Jenna; Fengdu Ghost City tickets; Qutang and Wu gorges sailing; Three Gorges Dam tour; half day guided Shanghai city tour; Oriental Pearl Tower tickets; Huangpu river cruise tickets; full day Great Wall at Mutianyu with the Summer Palace; guided Beijing city sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; China visa fees; meals beyond those listed; travel insurance; personal expenses.
